description: This file contains functions and types related to web fetch provider resolution, configuration, and runtime integration in a web-fetch module.

methods.name: resolveFetchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the web fetch configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if web fetch is enabled based on the fetch configuration and sandboxed status.

methods.name: readProviderEnvValue
methods.description: Reads environment variable values for a list of env var names, normalizing secret inputs.

methods.name: providerRequiresCredential
methods.description: Checks if a provider requires credentials.

methods.name: hasEntryCredential
methods.description: Checks if a provider has valid credentials based on config and fetch data.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchProviderId
methods.description: Resolves the provider ID for web fetch based on configuration and available providers.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchDefinition
methods.description: Resolves the web fetch provider and its definition based on options, configuration, and runtime metadata.
